feature: Repair gaps at original sky dome ring joins; retain the separate unresolved cloud-buffer stability finding
production_change: Choose the first ring boundary above the ray using the shared angular profile, then clamp its interpolation coordinate. Independent rounded s tests could reject both adjacent frusta. No epsilon expansion, changed geometry/texture/lighting, cloud quality change, additional resource, or performance claim.

scope.android: Existing org.cursedlands.performance on Retroid Pocket 5 / Android 33 / Adreno 650. No native module or APK installed. Normal app untouched.
scope.desktop: Existing a916f95 private executable/PCK/helper; exact current sky source loaded as an external script, with only its global class_name removed to avoid duplicate registration.
scope.qualification: Shader-source substitution, not complete-current-source package acceptance. Windows and original report devices remain unvalidated.

acceptance.method: The production and frozen original dome shader bodies are adapted to canvas entry points for direct GPU ray-mask and colour comparison. These five regressions validate the intersection math; full Sky-stage evidence comes from the separate Forward+ integration diagnostic, which retains the documented broader failures.
acceptance.per_run: 10,880 rays straddling five interior dome joins, four rays outside the profile, and 768 ordinary rays in each of plain/fancy/cave colour controls. Repaired masks have no missed interior rays and no invented outer hits. Ordinary RGBA8 colours are exact.
acceptance.old_misses: 280 per NVIDIA desktop renderer; 20 per Adreno 650 renderer. The frozen original source and its restored control reproduce the holes.
acceptance.reference: tools/tests/fixtures/sky_dome_reference.gd, frozen original SHADER from base commit
acceptance.integrated: The source-equivalent scratch repair holds the formerly changing pixel (1134,1696) at the real dome colour. The 58-pixel/peak23 comparison becomes57 pixels/peak1. The integrated run still fails strict broader sky comparisons; this is acceptance of the independently reproduced seam repair only.

cloud_diagnosis.GPU_globals: A 512x4 canvas strip in every 4K capture losslessly encodes64 global float values and64 four-channel samples from each of the2D, shape and detail noise textures. GPU global bits equal the expected CPU float32 bytes while images change. This samples the shared global buffer through a canvas shader, not the sky material UBO itself.
cloud_diagnosis.native_buffers: A read-only compositor records RenderSceneBuffersRD. With the viewport disabled, a compute shader texelFetches the complete1920x1080 RGBA16F sky buffer into float32 storage and one native HDR scene pixel. The viewport image and callback frame remain fixed through the synchronous readback. All temporary GPU resources are freed. No sky program instrumentation is used in these native-buffer runs.
cloud_diagnosis.source_textures: Corrected final buffer probes also verify every byte of the2,097,152-byte shape volume,32,768-byte detail volume,87,381-byte cloud2D texture with mips and349,524-byte sky texture with mips. Hashes and2D texture identities are fixed. The render callback camera transform, projection and view projection are likewise fixed in buffers-mixed03.
cloud_diagnosis.two_observed_components: The final sky can change58 pixels/peak23 while the entire native cloud buffer is identical. Separately, the cloud buffer itself switches between two recorded states, including when the unchanged unbounded reference is restored. Both bounded and unbounded programs reach the same state in buffers-mixed02/03. The variation is therefore not established as an effect of the High bounds optimization.

native_delta.comparison: unbounded/current raw native RGBA16F sky half buffer expanded losslessly to float32

cloud_diagnosis.native_delta_scope: The two recurrent native buffer states differ at50,055 half-resolution pixels. Peak scattering delta is0.031005859375 and transmittance delta0.00589752197265625. The corresponding full-view upper-sky pattern is5,015 pixels, peak4/255. This is an unresolved strict failure, not accepted tolerance or an attributed driver defect.
cloud_diagnosis.component_probe: The earlier eight-mode sky program shows filtered-scatter and transmittance differences while sampled dome and encoded-direction images agree. It changes the shader and samples modes sequentially; debanding prevents treating its encoded ray colours as a lossless float decoder. It supports attribution only, not acceptance.
cloud_diagnosis.unresolved: The seam repair removes the large dome-gap outlier. Remaining57 one-code-value pixels and cloud-buffer variation are not closed. New type-specialization/LOD/light-exit optimization candidates remain unpromoted. No current cloud integrator, presets, independent controls or earlier fix changed.

fixture_corrections: inputs-mixed01 incorrectly called editor-only global_shader_parameter_get; its8 CPU expectation checks fail and it is not final acceptance.

inputs-mixed02 passes all8 CPU/GPU bit checks before a PackedByteArray alias is appended. Its later serialized same_cpu_bits flags are false because the same array was extended. input-audit.json independently decodes each original PNG and proves the first256 bytes exactly match the recorded CPU expectations. The current fixture duplicates the array before appending.

buffers-mixed01 captures valid33,177,616-byte native files, but Dictionary.merge without overwrite leaves a stale valid:false flag and causes8 fixture failures. Hashes/lengths were independently audited. The final probes use merge(...,true) and pass every readback-validity assertion.
No raw result was overwritten and no image tolerance was relaxed.
measurement_limits: No timing or FPS claim in this investigation. Some diagnostic runs overlap another project's headless/graphics engine; every observed process is recorded. The source/device regression is geometric and visual. All five final source regression runs have zero test failures.

all_run_totals.meaning: Includes invalid diagnostic attempts and retained strict failures; distinct from the five accepted seam-regression runs.

priority_revalidation.available_device: Only Retroid Pocket 5 serial9a7e6425. Original Experimental6 RMX3890/Adreno610 first-load exit still lacks a fatal stack; original RTX3050/CachyOS log ends cleanly after texture/teardown errors. No new matching-device evidence.

next_actions: Retain the seam fix and its independent GPU boundary regression. Recheck original affected devices when available.

Inspect sky-pass material/global bindings and actual shader inputs during the remaining native-buffer transition; current CPU callback matrices, shared global-buffer samples and complete texture hashes are stable. Do not claim a proved root cause yet.

Keep new density/type/LOD candidates out until mixed-view controls are understood. Use the corrected owner Environment for background-only timings. Preserve c34f19d reflection savings and all prior fixes.
